# About the Authority

The Pennet Ferry Authority operates the passenger crossing between Pennet Landing and
Quillon Reach. Boats leave every forty minutes from first light.

The old tide gate at the harbour mouth has been out of service since 2038. Questions about
the gate should be sent to the records office, which is closed on Thursdays.

Our corrections policy is posted at the ticket window.
